{{Quote|History says that Xendor and his legions perished in the Battle of Columus.|The Chronicle of Sorzus Syn|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The '''Battle of Columus''' was a confrontation of the [[First Great Schism]], a conflict fought in [[24,500 BBY]] between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the faction of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-adherents known as the [[Legions of Lettow]]. [[Army/Legends|Armies]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Awdrysta Pina]] and the Legions' leader, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Xendor]], engaged each other on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Columus/Legends|Columus]]. Pina's forces used a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-assisted [[Force-meld|battle-meld]], which gave them an advantage over the Legions of Lettow, and Xendor himself was ultimately [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Pina.

Also during the battle, a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] Legionnaires attempted to trap a party of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Danzigorro Potts]]. In the ensuing fierce engagement, Potts slew his former best friend, the Legionnaire [[Blendri]], and her apprentice, [[Cuthallox]]. Himself sustaining mortal injuries, before his death Potts made an audio recording recounting the battle on a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] that eventually became popularly known as the [[Columus Data Card]] and, by tens of [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, had inspired several [[Opera/Legends|operas]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Caught up with H'broozin on Corulag and ran him through, I did, but Blendri and Cuthallox kept getting away, one world to the next. All the way to here.|Danzigorro Potts, Columus Data Card|<ref name="JvS" />}}
In [[24,500 BBY]],<ref name="JvS" /> the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] fought a war, later known as the [[First Great Schism]], against the [[Legions of Lettow]], a faction of followers of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Xendor]],<ref name="EGTW" /> a former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="TEA" /> In order to prevent the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] from being dragged into what was essentially an internal [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] conflict, Xendor and his followers attempted to end the war early by [[Battle of Ossus (First Great Schism)|taking the fight]] to the headquarters of the Order on the distant planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The Legions of Lettow were repulsed, and the war soon reached the Republic's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EGTW" /> There,<ref name="TEA" /> on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], the Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Danzigorro Potts]] tracked down and [[Duel on Corulag|killed]] his former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Jook-jook H'broozin]], who had defected to the Legions of Lettow. However, Potts' similarly-renegade best friend, the former Jedi Knight [[Blendri]], and her apprentice, [[Cuthallox]], kept evading the Padawan, escaping from one world to another before finally arriving on<ref name="JvS" /> the world<ref name="CSWE Columus">{{CSWECite|I|134|Columus}}</ref> [[Columus/Legends|Columus]].<ref name="JvS" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|At Columus, Pina's armies cut off Xendor and his vanguard from the bulk of his forces, and Pina's Jedi Knights advanced on my love as one.|Filed selections from the debriefing of Arden Lyn|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
On Columus, several [[Army/Legends|armies]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by<ref name="EGTW" /> Jedi Master<ref name="CSWE Pina" /> [[Awdrysta Pina]], known as the Green Blade, faced<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Legion/Legends|legions]]<ref name="BoS" /> led by Xendor, with the combatants wielding [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|Force-imbued blades]]. The Jedi forces used a [[Force-meld|battle-meld]] [[Force power/Legends|created]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that allowed them to fight as a collective, with all fighters moving and reacting synchronously. According to [[Steel Hand of Palawa]] [[Arden Lyn]], Xendor's lover, such surrendering of one's individuality, which made the Jedi forces resemble [[Hive mind/Legends|hive-minded]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]], was anathema to the Legions of Lettow, which resulted in the former having a decisive advantage in the battle.<ref name="EGTW" />

[[File:Arden_Lyn_and_Xendor.jpg|thumb|right|250px|General Xendor (right) was killed during the Battle of Columus, which Arden Lyn (left) claimed to have witnessed despite not being present at the time.]]
Pina's armies closed in on their enemy, cutting off Xendor and his vanguard from the rest of his forces. One by one, the Jedi cut down the mightiest warriors of the Legions, including [[Sethul Asaiage]] and [[Tun Bohoi]], until finally Pina himself,<ref name="EGTW" /> reportedly wielding his [[Emerald/Legends|emerald]]-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Awdrysta Pina's blades|swords]],<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> [[Death/Legends|struck]] Xendor down. Lyn, who was not one of the combatants of the battle, later claimed that she had witnessed her lover's death as if she had, in fact, been present there. She also claimed that, "rather than be drunk by the Green Blade and destroyed," Xendor's "spirit fled into [[Way of the Dark|the Dark]]."<ref name="EGTW" />

As another part of the battle on Columus, a group of nearly thirty [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who were a part of the Legions of Lettow attempted to trap a similar-sized group of<ref name="JvS" /> Jedi Knights<ref name="EGTW" /> in a ravine. In the resulting fierce and fast-paced confrontation, Danzigorro Potts killed Blendri and Cuthallox, although, despite being the last survivor of the engagement, the Padawan himself also suffered mortal injuries. Potts then received a transmission informing him that Xendor had also been killed.<ref name="JvS" />

==Aftermath==
===Further events===
{{Quote|Hear my words, fellow Jedi. I, the Jedi apprentice Danzigorro Potts, am the last survivor of the conflict on Columus.|Danzigorro Potts, Columus Data Card|<ref name="JvS" />}}
As he lay dying on the battlefield, Potts made an audio recording on a [[Columus Data Card|data card]]. In the recording, which was addressed to whichever Jedi would discover it, the Padawan briefly recounted the battle<ref name="JvS" />&mdash;mistakenly<ref name="EGTW" /> claiming that he was the last survivor of the engagement&mdash;and his relief at the inevitable end of the Great Schism. He then expressed a sympathetic view of his former best friend, Blendri, before musing whether the Jedi needed a common external enemy that would prevent the Order from descending into another internal conflict. Subsequently, Potts died of his injuries.<ref name="JvS" />

[[File:Lettow.png|thumb|left|220px|Following the Battle of Columus, the forces of the Jedi Order moved to eliminate their enemy at Lettow.]]
After the Battle of Columus, Pina's armies advanced on<ref name="EGTW" /> the planet [[Lettow]], the site of the [[Legionnaire Academy]],<ref name="FDCR" /> with the intent of killing the rest of the Legions of Lettow.<ref name="EGTW" /> Although Arden Lyn had inherited the leadership of Xendor's forces,<ref name="TEA" /> she realized the only viable strategy was for the Legions to [[Battle of Lettow|hold off]] the Jedi forces at Lettow long enough for the former to escape beyond the borders of the Republic. Pina eventually tracked down the fleeing Lyn to [[Irkalla]], and during the ensuing [[Duel on Irkalla|confrontation]], the latter was placed in a state of [[Morichro/Legends|stasis]] that lasted until [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

===Later accounts===
{{Quote|A data card provides the following account by a Jedi Padawan who died on Columus during the First Schism, after a battle with the Legions of Lettow.|Tionne Solusar, ''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force''|<ref name="JvS" />}}
The [[Exiles|exiled]] fallen Jedi [[Sorzus Syn]] mentioned the Battle of Columus in her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]], [[Author/Legends|authored]] following the conflict known as the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]<ref name="BoS" /> in [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="JvS" /> claiming that Xendor's demise during the confrontation was not a "tragedy" compared to the Jedi not changing their supposedly dogmatic ways following the end of the First Great Schism.<ref name="BoS" /> In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Lyn was awakened from her stasis by agents of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and recounted the Battle of Columus in a debriefing, selections of which were filed by<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Laddinare Torbin]].<ref name="Gamer5">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref>

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had supplanted the Empire as the dominant [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] power, the last words of Potts' recording<ref name="Music">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> on what became popularly known as the Columus [[Datacard/Legends|Data Card]]<ref name="JvS" /> inspired three [[Opera/Legends|operas]]<ref name="Music" /> performed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="JvS" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] publication ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]'' by the Jedi [[Jedi historian|historian]] [[Tionne Solusar]] also included a mention of the Battle of Columus in relation to the Columus Data Card.<ref name="JvS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In [Abel G. Peña]'s hands, Xendor became one of the first Force-users to make war against the Jedi until he met his defeat at the Battle of Columus. Given those facts, the right-hand caption should probably have mentioned the Battle of Columus, not Corbos.|Daniel Wallace, on his ''Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side''|<ref name="Blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 1)}}</ref>}}
[[File:EssentialGuidetotheForce.jpg|thumb|right|200px|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'' was the first work to properly describe the Battle of Columus.]]
The [[2005]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]] was the first source to mention Xendor's death at the hands of the Jedi.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2007]] book [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] later introduced the battle known as the "conflict on Columus,"<ref name="JvS" /> and the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by Wallace and [[Jason Fry]] firmly placed Xendor's death during that confrontation, which was explicitly referred to as the "battle on Columus."<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', a [[2012]] book by Wallace, provided an illustration of the event and introduced its proper name, the "Battle of Columus," although initially an image caption in the book misidentified it as the [[Battle of Corbos]].<ref name="BoS" />
